title: Track Guide Summit Point Mazda MX5 Fixed iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake hard at two cones, trail brake to curb
corners.line: follow repaved part around, touch curb
corners.exit: full throttle, get to right when repaved part stops
corners.mistakes: hitting curb too much unsettles car

corners.braking: use tree as reference, brake to 40% when tree out of sight
corners.line: apex in middle, take some inside curb

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: Feel when car is settled, brake hard initially, trail brake to curb
corners.line: Follow repaved part, apex where curb and repaved part meet

corners.braking: Quick hit of brakes to 60%, trail brake to repaved part
corners.line: Follow repaved part, apex where curb and repaved part meet
corners.exit: Go on throttle after apex, smooth inputs

corners.label: T7
corners.line: Take a bit of curb, follow repaved part
Get close to curb but do not touch, avoid grass on inside
corners.mistakes: Do not touch curb or grass

corners.line: Turn in early for uphill curve
corners.exit: Use all curb on outside if necessary

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: patch of dirt on left, quick 50% brake, roll into curb
corners.line: turn in early, use curb on outside
corners.exit: apply throttle on curb, use asphalt and curb on outside
corners.mistakes: touching gravel loses momentum, car goes sideways

general_tips: good overtaking places: turn one and t three
for qual, be left for t one, right for t three
6 7 8 and 9 are essential for lap times
